blocks.text: Rasulullaah ﷺ Forbids Frightening a Muslim

Hadhrat Abul Hasan (RA) was a Sahabi who participated in the Pledge of Aqabah as well as in the Battle of Badr. He says, "We were sitting with Rasulullaah ﷺ when a man stood up (to leave), forgetting his shoes behind. Another person took his shoes and put it beneath him. When the returned, he then asked the others where his shoes were, they replied that they had not seen it. (After the Sahabi (RA) worriedly searched for his shoes) The other Sahabi (RA) (who hid it away) said, "Here are they." Rasulullaah ﷺ then remarked, "How will you answer (on the Day of Qiyaamah) for frightening a Mu'min?" The Sahabah (RA) explained, "I only did it in jest." However, Rasulullaah ﷺ repeated two or three times more, "How will you answer for frightening a Mu'min?"[^1]

Hadhrat Aamir bin Rabee'ah (RA) reports that a Sahabi (RA) once hid away the shoes of another Sahabi (RA) in jest. When the matter was reported to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he said, "Never frighten a Muslim because frightening a Muslim is a great injustice."[^2]

Hadhrat Nu'maan bin Basheer (RA) narrates that they were once on a journey with Rasulullaah ﷺ when one of them fell asleep on his animal. When another Sahabi (RA) removed an arrow from the sleeping man's quiver, he got up with a shock. Rasulullaah ﷺ rebuked the Sahabi (RA) saying, "It is not at all permissible for anyone to frighten a Muslim."[^3]

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Abu Layla
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Abu Layla reports that the Sahabah (RA) informed them that they were once travelling with Rasulullaah ﷺ when one of them fell asleep. Another person went and grabbed the rope that the sleeping man was holding, causing him to get a fright. Rasulullaah ﷺ rebuked the man saying, "It is not at all permissible for anyone to frighten a Muslim."[^4]

Hadhrat Sulaymaan bin Surad (RA) narrates that a Bedouin was once performing salaah with Rasulullaah ﷺ when someone took away the rope he had with him. After Rasulullaah ﷺ has completed the salaah with Salaam, the Bedouin exclaimed, "My rope!" Some of the Sahabah (RA) (involved in taking the rope away) were busy laughing. Rasulullaah ﷺ rebuked them saying, "Whoever believes in Allaah and the Last Day should never frighten a Muslim."[^5]

Tabraani, as quoted in Targheeb wat Tarheeb (Vol.4 Pg.263). Haythami (Vol.6 Pg.253) has commented on the chain of narrators. Ibnus Sakan has reported a similar narration, as quoted in Isaabah (Vol.4 Pg.43).
